admissions_overview.summary: In Sierra Leone each university receives and decides applications itself; there is no single national placement system for universities. For degree programmes the universities consulted ask for five credits at WASSCE or GCE O-Level (in not more than two sittings) including English Language, with extra subject requirements for some programmes. Diploma and certificate programmes ask for fewer credits.
admissions_overview.notes: Application windows, PIN or application procedures, programme availability and individual programme requirements change every year. Check the admissions page of the university you want (for example admissions.usl.edu.sl) each year.
